1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

258043|c6710551.name: Norric Lochthane
258043|c6710551.text: Ye've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around ye and ye shall fare far greater than most.

258139|0e6687ea.name: Frothrik Saegrund
258139|0e6687ea.text: Water's gift is balance. It cools the burning, softens the hardened, quiets the rattling spirits. When ye can guide that balance in others... ye'll know yer on the true path.

258203|a955ba26.name: Hervdana Saegrund
258203|a955ba26.text: Welcome to our humble home. Rest by the fire if ye need to dry off.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

4267|c5ceacbe.name: Daelyshia
4267|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

102-progress.name: Captain Danuvin
102-progress.text: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
102-progress.title: Patrolling Westfall

13-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-progress.text: We have not time to talk, $N.  The Defias Pillagers are denying the people of Westfall the peace and prosperity they deserve.  Make sure at least 15 Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters have been killed.  That will send a clear message that corruption is not welcome here.
13-progress.title: The People's Militia

141-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
141-progress.text: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?
141-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

151-progress.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-progress.text: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
151-progress.title: Poor Old Blanchy

22-progress.name: Salma Saldean
22-progress.text: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-progress.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

38-progress.name: Salma Saldean
38-progress.text:
Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-progress.title: Westfall Stew

469-progress.name: James Halloran
469-progress.text: Hello there, $c. Could I interest you in a pair of boots?  Perhaps some newly cured skins?
469-progress.title: Daily Delivery

94495-complete.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94495-complete.text:
Aye, I see it in yer eyes, $r. You're wonderin' what kind o' soul chooses to live out here, deep in the Wetlands, with Dark Iron scum lurkin' about and nary a guard in sight. Well, we all have our reasons, love. 

But the real question is, what brings you to our home? Out here at the edge of the falls, I reckon we both know the answer to that.

<Hervdana stretches out her arm, fingers catching mist spray from the waterfall.>
94495-complete.title: Call of Water

94497-progress.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94497-progress.text: I'm nearly ready to send ye off on the rest o' yer tasks. But tell me, have ye filled the skin yet? The ocean brings life, aye--but it carries sediment, minerals, and energies far different from the snowmelt and springwater of the highlands. Where sea and spring meet, there's wisdom to be found.
94497-progress.title: Call of Water

94499-progress.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94499-progress.text: The folk o' Lakeshire don't ken how good they've got it--fresh water flowin' right at their boots, keepin' their nets full, their crops green, and their coin purses jinglin'. Even when the kingdom's guard can barely spare a lad with a sword, they've got Everstill watchin' over 'em.
94499-progress.title: Call of Water

94500-complete.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94500-complete.text: Well done, $N! With all three samples in hand, I'll brew ye a vial o' water so pure it'd make the mountains weep. It's the final piece for yer rite o' passage. I'm proud to call ye kin, $N. Ye've done $c proud, and I look forward to hearing yer tales in the future.
94500-complete.title: Call of Water

94500-progress.name: Hervdana Saegrund
94500-progress.text: Do you have the water yet, $N? If ye haven't made the trek to Kalimdor yet, be careful.
94500-progress.title: Call of Water

94501-progress.name: Norric Lochthane
94501-progress.text:
Hello again, $N. Yer looking well. 

What brings you back to me so soon?
94501-progress.title: Call of Water

94502-progress.name: Norric Lochthane
94502-progress.text: The shrine stands aged and forgotten, cloaked in dust and cobwebs. The pond beside it lies eerily still, its surface untouched by wind or life. Scattered along the shore are the bones of beasts once burdened by labor. The water's murky sheen raises a troubling question--has it been poisoned by the surrounding malaise, or is it the very source of it?
94502-progress.title: Call of Water
